# cameractrls attribution

The unmodified `cameractrls.py` backend is from https://github.com/soyersoyer/cameractrls,
version v0.6.10 as reported by the source, retrieved 2026-10-27.
Upstream source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/soyersoyer/cameractrls/main/cameractrls.py
License: LGPL-3.0-or-later. The upstream SPDX identifier is retained as
`cameractrls-LICENSE`; full license texts are in `COPYING.LESSER` (LGPL v3)
and `COPYING` (GPL v3, incorporated by the LGPL), from the GNU Project:
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.txt and https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt.
The file remains separate, readable Python source; Laptop Control communicates with
its unprivileged Python bridge using JSON rather than embedding a GTK UI.
